source_tree_fingerprint.algorithm: sha256 over sorted (path, sha256(content)) of `git ls-files -co --exclude-standard`, excluding docs/implementation-progress/

code_intelligence_ts_js.scope: TS/TSX/JS/JSX/ESM/CommonJS symbols, ownership, exports/re-exports, imports/requires/dynamic imports, diagnostics; language-adapter interface; content-addressed facts; per-grammar extractors; incremental reindex; atomic generations; freshness; CLI queries
limits: syntax-level facts only: no call graph, no compiler/SCIP resolution

module_relationships.scope: per-generation module_edges (resolved/external/unresolved/ambiguous/dynamic) from a deterministic resolver; tsconfig paths/baseUrl/extends, declared workspaces

graph.detail: Module-level edges exist and are queryable (`engbrain imports`). There is NO language-neutral graph schema (graph_nodes / graph_edges), no node kinds beyond symbols, no traversal, path, cycle detection or impact query, no EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS/REFERENCES edges. That is Phase 2B.

retrieval.detail: Persisted-data CLI queries only (`symbols`, `imports`, `status`). No context packets, no token budgeting, no MCP server. That is Phase 2C.

commit_ledger.detail: No Git DAG ledger, no per-commit change records, no refresh command. The earlier Hive docs under docs/hive/ are plans only and are paused.

sandboxed_execution.detail: No OS isolation is implemented; operations that run repository code are refused (packages/security/src/offline.ts).

independent_review.substitute: a separate Claude agent reviewed the working tree read-only (same model family, fresh context). This is NOT a Codex review and not a strict independent audit.
